candidate-01.hypothesis_en: Two narrow exception-priority clarifications on the unchanged confirmed-stage policy: a repeated category/location label in otherwise equivalent generic marketing is not a concrete product record without an independent product-specific fact or changed offer term; and a covered stock-cookie paragraph does not acquire an additional category-specific necessity obligation from its new heading alone. Align existing delta and primary-difference options with those finite exceptions. Actual products/specifications, transaction destinations, named liability, explicit category terms, concrete deployment restrictions and substantive body languages remain protected. Previous broad descendants mixed UI/failed-target/class-instance rules and had format failures; this isolates their approved cookie-scope clarification on the original stable stage parent, without transplanting those other rules. Actual prior main replies explicitly bypassed allowed provider exceptions by labeling them content additions, and a coverage reply acknowledged shared copy yet invented a new category obligation. Preserve all native fields/order/enums, response contract, evidence, model, sampling, executor and strict validator. First screen original hard presentations plus separately frozen cookie-scope positive/negative controls; no long inference solely to retry a failure.
candidate-01.hypothesis_zh: 在原样确认阶段政策上澄清两项窄范围例外的优先级：等价通用营销中的重复类别或地点标签，如无独立产品事实或变化的销售条件，不构成具体产品记录；已覆盖的通用cookie段落也不因新的标题单独产生额外类别专属的必需义务。同步既有差异及主差异选项与这些有限例外。真实产品及规格、交易去向、责任主体名称、明确类别条款、具体部署限制及实质正文语言继续受保护。既往宽泛后继版本混合了界面、失败目标及类别实例规则，并存在格式失败；本次只把其中已批准的cookie范围澄清置于原有稳定阶段父版本，不移植其他规则。真实既往main回复明确把允许的服务商槽位称为内容新增而绕过例外；coverage回复也曾承认复制共享文字却推断新的类别义务。保留全部原生字段、顺序、枚举、回复格式、证据、模型、采样、执行器及严格校验。先运行原硬呈现及单独冻结的cookie范围正反例；不为重试失败而直接增加长推理。

candidate-01-coverreasonfirst1.hypothesis_en: Engineering-only coverage response-order experiment: ask the existing explanation paragraph and whole-notice comparison before choosing loss IDs, then emit the unchanged remaining fields. Previous actual coverage replies emit loss IDs before explaining the comparison and invent a category obligation or provider loss despite the existing exception; a prior order diagnostic proposed but never applied this experiment. The new semantic screen again has correct main decisions followed by those false coverage vetoes. All retention-policy paragraphs, main prompts/rubric, field names/types/enums, schema, validator, quoted evidence, critic veto authority, source presentation, model and sampling stay unchanged. This observation is not proof of causality: verify actual emitted order and native validity, then compare hard screens and separate cookie controls. Reject if order is ignored or technical validity worsens; do not repeat failed groups to select a lucky sample.
candidate-01-coverreasonfirst1.hypothesis_zh: 仅对coverage回复顺序进行工程实验：要求先生成既有explanation段落并完成全篇比较，再选择损失ID，之后输出不变的其余字段。既往真实coverage回复先给损失ID再解释比较，尽管存在例外仍推断类别义务或服务商损失；此前顺序诊断提出但未实际实施过这一实验。新的语义筛查再次出现main判断正确后被coverage误否决。全部保留政策段落、main提示词与rubric、字段名类型枚举、schema、校验器、引用证据、critic只能否决的权限、原文呈现、模型及采样均不变。该观察不证明因果：须核验实际输出顺序及原生有效性，再比较硬回归与单独cookie反例。若顺序未生效或技术有效性退步则淘汰，不重复失败组以挑选幸运样本。

candidate-02.hypothesis_en: One shared-basis consistency clarification for the already approved finite generic-marketing exception. The preceding main failure explicitly classifies the otherwise preserved promotional message as template-only and chooses no basis, although category/location labels alone are permitted. State that this complete qualified message remains a verified retained basis even when brief or reusable; exclude shared navigation/layout around different actual records and preserve independent product facts or offer differences. No new family of slot exceptions, profile definition, output field/order/enum, source, model, sampling, schema, executor or validator change. Keep every other parent policy and any separately verified coverage-order engineering intervention unchanged. This addresses the observed basis-none path rather than repeating the already tested identity wording.
candidate-02.hypothesis_zh: 仅澄清已批准的有限通用营销例外与共享依据的一致性。前一main失败明确把已保留的营销文字视为仅有模板而选择无依据，尽管类别及地点标签本身已被允许。明确完整且满足条件的相同营销文字即使简短或可复用，仍构成经核验的保留依据；排除不同真实记录周围的共享导航及版式，继续保护独立产品事实或销售条件差异。不新增槽位例外类别、不改内容角色定义、输出字段及顺序枚举、原文、模型、采样、schema、执行器或校验器。父版本其余政策及任何已单独核验的coverage顺序工程干预均保持不变。该实验针对实际无依据路径，不重复已测试的身份措辞。
